name: Warm Green Bean Salad with Tempeh, Carrot, Cucumber & Peanut Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, maple syrup, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup rice vinegar
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tempeh. Place in a large bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, and stir to coat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tempeh and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 5-7 minutes. Transfer tempeh to a plate, season with salt, and cover with foil; set aside. (Reserve skillet and bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
6 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1.02 kg green beans
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in the reserved bowl along with peanut butter, vinegar, soy sauce, water, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup natural peanut butter
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp water
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp black pepper
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Trim and halve green beans crosswise.

Return the skillet to high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green beans and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until blistered and tender, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the other veggies. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
When the green beans have cooled slightly, add to the bowl along with pickled shallots. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; top with crispy tempeh and reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
